decision_clause: The decision ruled out “pin every prose field by literal digest”; only contract-derived or numerically fixed fields may be pinned because freezing full prose duplicates the contract and makes editorial changes fail.

rationale: The final tree does not implement the ruled-out prose-digest strategy. It appears not to implement the requested public type-contract change at all, but task incompleteness is distinct from violating the recorded decision.
